changes.comment: BREAKING: JsonSchema nodes carry constraint and annotation keywords. number/integer take minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum and multipleOf; string takes minLength, maxLength and format; every factory takes title, default and examples. Validating keywords are enforced and every keyword is emitted by toJson(); a factory throws on an incoherent option set. fromJson now enforces and emits the same keywords from a raw schema, so a value it used to accept (1 against minimum 5) is now rejected, and an incoherent or mistyped constraint is refused. fromJson also refuses minLength/maxLength beside a string enum. New JsonSchema.adaptSchemaKeywords passes, translates, folds (constraints as 'Constraints: ...', annotations as their own sentences) or drops (annotations only) each keyword for one provider wire; JsonSchema.validateNumberOptions and validateStringOptions run the factory checks as a Result.
